integrity: The analytical proof is finite Dirichlet hitting and controlled asymptotic expansions; exact arithmetic checks are corroborative and not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: The random initial position is uniform on the upper dyadic half, not stationary.
Only p in [1/2,1] is treated; the below-threshold process need not return.
The statistic is maximum shell depth per completed excursion, distinct from first-return time.
Priority of the exact excursion-extreme profile warrants independent checking against older random-walk excursion literature.
title: Exact maximum-depth excursions and two critical crossovers in the Pelikan random map
